entries.embedded_english: The 42's history! Let's move!
Hell no, Sarge.
We've got to fall back, Sarge.
You think the US Army sent us all this way just to show the Germans how we fall back?
Well, we ain't getting through on this road. The krauts are throwing everything they've got at us.
Baker company are pushing up with the tanks.  You think they're gonna take this town without help from us,Tucker?
Then we're going in, starting with an assault on that big house up ahead.
We'll use the stream to flank their position. Go! Get off the road!
What's the news from batallion, Sarge?
So?
On your feet, Gibson.
Tank!
That's the last of them. The square's secure.
Let's go! Move it! Go!
That side street. If we flank the panzer we might get close enough to put a dent in it.
Too late, Sarge.
Gibson! We're moving out!
Panzer! Panzer on the road to the North!
Get away from the windows!
Gibson. Clear the upstairs.
Do you hear that?
Enemy vehicles heading this way!
Maybe they're bringing up reinforcements.
They know we're here?
Won't take them long to find out...
Hold fire until they're in range. Gibson, be ready on that MG 42.
Keep hitting them! Don't let them regroup.
Tucker, the trapdoor! Get it open!
Looks clear. Move out.
The Panzer's moving. We need to be someplace else!
Keep your heads down.
Freezing my ass off, here. Krauts better be waiting with a nice log fire in there.
How about some hot lead? That warm you up any?
The Germans have given up the bridge head. They're falling back across the Sure River.
Bastogne's where we're headed next.
We're not done yet.  We need to push up to secure the river crossings in the town centre.
Looks like they're getting ready to pull out.
We've caught them cold! Let's move on them fast!
Where's the goddamn Sherman!?
Panzershreck! Second floor window!
Get to cover! Spread out!
Gunner, target that window!
Panzer! Panzer to the north!
Aw, crap! It's coming this way!
We’re sitting ducks here!
Go! Keep moving!
Get out, Gibson! Move, you dumb son of a…
Troop transports! Hit 'em hard!
Get inside!
More of 'em! By the broken wall!
Watch those windows on the 2nd floor.
Good work.
I think we've punched a whole kraut division square on the nose.
Gibson, take the lead.
Look out! MG 42! Left side window.
Wait for the tank to nail that M G position!
Move! Get into the cellar!
Fight your way through! Keep moving!
I need the tank forward! What's the hold up!?
Watch those ruins.
In poor order too, I reckon. Look at all the gear they left behind. Not bad for a day's work by the Blue Ridgers.
Move forward with the tank.
We have to secure this square. Keep up the fire!
Here it comes!!!!
Krauts in the yard! To the North!
They're hitting our left flank!
Gibson. Get some fire onto them from the bedroom!
Rush them!
Germans! In the outhouse!
We ain't stopping a Tank, Sarge. Not with these pea-shooters
Alright. We keep moving - head further into town and hope we run into our own tanks.
Infantry. In the building across the street.
Move!Tucker, clear that doorway!
Go! Go!
Yeah, well the good news is we tied down at least two kraut divisions in this sector. That’s two divisions won’t be reaching Bastogne.
Open fire!
Tucker. Get that damn door open!
I'm trying. It's jammed on something!
Get it open now!
We can't stay here. That tank's gonna bury us.
Okay,  get across the street and regroup in the building opposite.
That showed 'em who's boss. They're pulling back.
Push up. Storm the house.
Upstairs clear!
Regroup on me.
Don't give them chance to deploy.
Move out.
No way out!
MG, upper floor on the right side.
Get clear. The Sherman's gonna blast that position.
I want fire superiority! Keep it up!
That  tank' still out there!
